shellCommands.command: ls -la && git status --short && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v "^./.git/" | head -100

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo ---; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls __agent_eval__; cat .claude/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md | head -5; diff -r .agents/skills .claude/skills && echo SAME

npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20 && npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -20 && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependencies)" && cat package.json

node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependenciesMeta)"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60; echo ----; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Checkbox Link ThemeProvider Card Text 2>&1 | head -120

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Checkbox Button Link Card ThemeProvider Text 2>&1 | head -80; echo ----; rg -n -i -A 25 "required setup" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && rg -n -i "setup|ThemeProvider|styles.css|fonts.css" build/docs/INDEX.md README.md | head -40; echo ----; ls build/docs/guides; echo ----; rg -n -C3 "styles|fonts" build/docs/guides/*.md | head -60

sed -n 40,70p README.md; echo ----; rg -n "ThemeProvider" build/index.d.ts build/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; ls build | head -40; echo ----; rg -n "export .*ThemeProvider|export .*\bProvider\b" build --glob '*.d.ts' | head

cat build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "TextInput|Checkbox|Button|Link|Text|Card|Flex|Box" build/docs/INDEX.md | head -40; echo ----; cat build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md 2>/dev/null | head -120 || ls build/docs/components/controls

sed -n 120,200p build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md | cut -c1-200; echo ----CHECKBOX; cat build/docs/components/Checkbox.md | cut -c1-220 | head -90; echo ----TEXTINPUT-DTS; cat build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60 || find build/esm -name "TextInput*.d.ts"

cat build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; rg -n "variant" build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "header-1|body-2|display-1" build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -5; echo ----; rg -n "width|type" build/docs/components/Button.md | head -20; echo ---; rg -n "Provider.*(ThemeProvider|theme)" build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -5; ls build/esm/components/Text; cat build/esm/index.d.ts | head -5
cat build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; rg -n "loading|type\?" build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts | head

sed -n 1,40p build/docs/components/Card.md | cut -c1-200; echo ---; rg -n "direction|gap|alignItems" build/esm/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts build/esm/components/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo ---; rg -n "view|size|type" build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -12
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build --outDir /tmp/login-build --emptyOutDir 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && rg -n "SpacingValue\b" build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -5; rg -n "export type SpacingValue" -A3 build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30 || rg -ln "BoxProps" build/esm --glob '*.d.ts'; echo ---; rg -n "gap|direction|spacing|padding|\bp\?" build/docs/guides/migration-layout-v8.md | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "TSC_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build --outDir /tmp/login-build --emptyOutDir 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -6; echo "BUILD_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; git status --short
npm audit --omit=dev 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; npm audit 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[a-z@].*(critical|high|moderate)|Severity" | head -20
